PRE-TREATMENT CARE INSTRUCTIONS

  • Stop topical acne regimen such as Retin-A, Tretinoin, Adapalene, Benzoyl Peroxide, Salicylic Acid 5 days prior to your peel.
  • If you have been on Accutane within the past 6 months you should not have a peel.

POST-TREATMENT INSTRUCTIONS

  • Redness and sensitivity might be present (and last up to a few days).
  • Do NOT wash your face.
  • Treat skin gently by washing with a gentle cleanser, cool water, using hands only, pat dry
    and immediately apply a gentle moisturizer.
  • No exercising or activities that cause excessive sweating.
  • Avoid showers or wetting your face
  • Avoid sun tanning and prolonged exposure to direct sunlight.
  • When exposed to sun, always use sunscreen SPF 30 or above.
  • Do not apply anything except approved products to your skin.
  • Peeling will begin 36-48 hours after peel (and last anywhere from 3-7 days).
  • Peeling can be similar to that of a sunburn or light flaking.
  • Do NOT pick or prematurely peel the skin.
  • May use mineral makeup after 12 hours but it is not recommended while you are peeling.
  • Repeat treatments in 4 weeks and for best results complete a series of 3 – 5 treatments.
